name: AICheckbox
description: AICheckbox is the AI-styled selection control for AI cards, drawers, and settings rows. It does NOT reimplement the checkbox — it wraps the standard `ZdsCheckbox` (the shared ZDS atom, mirror `src/checkbox/`) and re-anchors the ZDS selection / focus / text CSS variables to their AI equivalents inside a scoped wrapper. That means the checked fill and border become AI brand indigo (#4D60E6) instead of ZDS teal, the focus ring uses `AI.color.border.focus`, the label uses `--ai-zds-text`, and the box corners are softened to match the AI card family — while every accessibility guarantee, the indeterminate dash, error mode, sizing, and disabled state are inherited from ZDS unchanged.
intent: The ZDS Checkbox in AI clothing — same accessible control, AI brand indigo selection, focus ring, and label styling for AI surfaces.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
